title_as_printed: Experimental Bunsen Solubility Coefficients for Methane in Distilled Water and Seawater
footnotes_as_printed: none (salinity in parts per thousand, Temp in deg C, beta Bunsen coefficient)
pressure_note: Bunsen coefficient defined at gas partial pressure of 760 mm Hg (1 atm); not a measured cell pressure

composition.other_species: seawater of salinity S (parts per thousand), composition not given in this paper; salinity 0.0 is distilled water

skip_rows.reason: salinity label rows (data columns empty); salinity is set via group_rows

conversion_needs: Bunsen coefficient = volume of gas (STP) absorbed per unit volume of water at measurement temperature at 760 mm partial pressure; conversion to mole fraction needs water density and molar volume
salinity (ppt) is seawater, composition not that of NaCl: salt-ion set not directly mappable
notes: Block layout: each salinity block lists three column groups (Temp, beta); stacked in printed column-group order, group 1 first then 2 then 3. Salinity values 27.738, 33.461, 33.515, 33.629, 39.379 are measured sample salinities. Values already corrected by authors for dissolved gas volume (partial molal volume 37 cm3, about +0.16%).
volume_basis_evidence: Yamamoto et al. 1976: "the volume of gas (corrected to STP) absorbed in a unit volume of water at the measurement temperature when the partial pressure of the gas is 760 mm"; also corrected for the dissolved-gas volume of the aqueous phase. Whether "water" means seawater (solution) is not stated.
